adaptation.inputs: Pi absolute path and edits[{oldText,newText}] map to a workspace-relative path and old_text/new_text
adaptation.success: Pi success text maps to ToolResult.error being None; the original English success text is not emitted by Mini-Pi
adaptation.diff_and_patch: Pi details.diff/details.patch map to the actual unified diff string in ToolResult.output
adaptation.patch_application: Pi applyPatch maps to independent git apply in a separate directory

additional_mini_pi_checks: Read the edited disk file back and compare it with the expected content
